summary_1line: Rama initiates the Ashvamedha sacrifice, releases the marked horse under Lakshmana’s watch, and hosts kings, priests, monkeys, and rakshasas at the Naimisha sacrificial grounds.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama releases a black-spotted ceremonial horse bearing his royal insignia while priests and Lakshmana stand ready beside the sacrificial ground.
A vast sacrificial camp in Naimisha Wood filled with ornate pavilions, gathered kings, monkeys serving priests, and rakshasas escorting austere rishis.
Lakshmana vigilantly guards the wandering ritual horse as it departs the sacrificial grounds under priestly supervision.
